ul.li: Non-Guaranteed reservation will be kept till 16:00 hrs on the day of arrival, unless informed about late arrival.
Guest check-in before morning 06:00am will be charged from the previous day.
The hotel check-in is 14:00 hrs and out time is 12:00 noon, early check-in and late checkout is available on request, subject to room availability and prior approval from the Front Office Manager.
In case of no show one day will be charged and cancellation before 48 hrs there is no charge.
